name: angry
title: Angry
description: Controlled anger and frustration; sharp, clipped, intense.
instruct: Speak with sharp, controlled anger and frustration, clipped and intense.
sample: Who approved this? [groan] Seriously. Who looked at a function that stores passwords in plain text and thought, yes, ship it, Friday at five, no review? I want names. I want a timeline. And I want the coffee machine fixed, because clearly nobody here is awake.
